summary: Single pass: build the Express API for standup updates (server-side PGlite persistence) and the frontend that posts to and lists from it.

tasks.title: Build the standup tracker API and frontend
tasks.instructions: Create server/db.js (PGlite-backed persistence for updates), server/routes/updates.js (GET/POST /api/updates), server/app.js (Express app wiring the router), src/App.jsx (posts an update and lists them via fetch), and src/components/UpdatesList.jsx (renders the list).
